title: Gate evaluation
description: Immutable derived decision whether an action may be performed on pinned artifact revisions, based on validation reports, optional quality evidence bundles, a profile and waivers (design decisions ADR-016 and ADR-025 §11.4: domain validation and test evidence stay separate, and a gate references both). The decision follows a deterministic procedure, first matching step wins: (1) 'deny' with 'd2p:report-missing' if no report is referenced; (2) 'deny' with 'd2p:report-stale' if a report has a different profile, a different target set or a finding whose rule version differs from the profile; (3) 'deny' with 'd2p:report-failed' if a report has status 'failed'; (4) 'deny' with 'd2p:evidence-missing' if a referenced evidence bundle lacks a report for one of its required suites (QEV-012); (5) 'deny' with 'd2p:evidence-not-passed' if a referenced evidence bundle has an 'overallState' other than 'passed'; (6) 'deny' with 'd2p:blocking-findings' if a finding of severity 'error' or 'critical' is not addressed by a valid waiver; (7) 'pending-approval' with 'd2p:approval-required' if the profile requires approvals; (8) 'allow-with-warning' with 'd2p:warnings-present' if a finding of severity 'warning' is not addressed by a valid waiver; (9) otherwise 'allow'. 'reasonCodes' is the sorted set of the deciding step's reason code plus 'd2p:waived' if 'addressedFindings' is not empty (checked as D2P-SEM-102).

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a gate evaluation.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

gateEvaluationId.description: Own ID of this gate evaluation (prefix 'gte').

evaluatedAt.description: UTC time the gate was evaluated. Excluded from 'resultDigest'.

targetRefs.description: Pinned artifact revisions the action applies to, sorted by artifactId, revisionId.

profile.description: Validation profile (ID and version) the gate applies.

reportRefs.description: Validation reports the decision is based on, sorted by id, digest. Each reference carries the report's 'resultDigest' in 'digest' (required).

evidenceRefs.description: Quality evidence bundles (test and benchmark evidence) the decision is also based on, sorted by id, digest. Each reference carries the bundle's digest in 'digest' (required; the bundle's contentDigest per catalog §1.5 rule 5). Each bundle's 'gate' equals this gate's 'profile' and its 'subjectRefs' equal 'targetRefs' as sets (D2P-REF-007). Omitted when the gate uses no test evidence; no 1.0 validation profile requires evidence.

waiverIds.description: Waivers considered by the gate, as a sorted set.

reasonCodes.description: Sorted set of reason codes: the deciding step's code (none for 'allow') plus 'd2p:waived' if findings were addressed by waivers.

addressedFindings.description: Every finding addressed by a valid waiver, sorted by reportId, findingId; empty when the decision is made in steps 1 to 5.

resultDigest.description: Digest of this document excluding 'contentDigest', 'resultDigest', 'gateEvaluationId' and every top-level member ending in 'At' (digest profile d2p-digest-v1).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

gateAction.title: Gate action
gateAction.description: Action guarded by a gate. 'edit-draft', 'export-1to1' and 'cut-sample' correspond to the validation purposes 'draft-edit', '1to1-print' and 'sample-cut'.

reasonCode.title: Reason code
reasonCode.description: Extensible reason for a gate decision.

addressedFinding.title: Addressed finding
addressedFinding.description: A finding of a referenced report that is addressed by a valid waiver.

findingId.description: ID of the finding within that report.
